# S/MIME Signature

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SMIMESignature`](gmeow-SMIMESignature.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SMIMESignature>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An S/MIME signature (RFC 8551) over a message, bound to an X.509 certificate.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SMIMESignature`](gmeow-SMIMESignature.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a signature is specifically an S/MIME signature (RFC 8551) bound to an X.509 certificate — the scheme-typed specialization of [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an OpenPGP signature (use [`gmeow:PGPSignature`](gmeow-PGPSignature.md)) and for a scheme-agnostic case (use the parent [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md)); the type fixes the X.509/S-MIME scheme.

### How to use

- Type the signature [`gmeow:SMIMESignature`](gmeow-SMIMESignature.md) and bind [`gmeow:signingKey`](../properties/gmeow-signingKey.md) to a key whose [`gmeow:keyScheme`](../properties/gmeow-keyScheme.md) is [`gmeow:keySchemeX509`](../individuals/gmeow-keySchemeX509.md); [`signedBy`](../properties/gmeow-signedBy.md), algorithm, and verification status come from the parent.

### Examples

- ex:sig2 a [`gmeow:SMIMESignature`](gmeow-SMIMESignature.md); [`gmeow:signingKey`](../properties/gmeow-signingKey.md) ex:x509Key.
